user_query: I want to entertain my family during dinner with some jokes. Retrieve random jokes from the Chuck Norris Jokes API and provide me with a selection of jokes from the Jokes by API-Ninjas API to create a fun and enjoyable mealtime.

TaskList.description: Retrieve random jokes from the Chuck Norris Jokes API to get a set of humorous content.
Fetch a selection of jokes from the Jokes by API-Ninjas API to diversify the humor content for the dinner.
